{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Knitted scarf with a short, chin-length fringe in warm copper to complement the left side of her hair, oversized relaxed fit, elbow length, earthy terracotta, soft wool blend.
Chunky knit sweater in neutral beige for an effortless everyday look, loose silhouette, hip length, oatmeal heather, cotton and cashmere.
High-rise tailored trousers in dark denim for a polished casual finish, straight leg cut, ankle length, deep charcoal blue, sturdy twill.
Leather Chelsea boots with a low block heel for autumn comfort and style, almond toe, mid-calf height, rich black, smooth calfskin.
This outfit perfectly balances her unique hair coloration by using the copper-toned scarf to echo the left side while keeping the rest neutral. The chin-length fringe of the accessory directly fulfills her specific wish without overwhelming her features. The dark trousers ground the warm tones and create a cohesive look suitable for an everyday autumn walk."}
